newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on weak cash, harvest.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on weak cash, harvest.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on weak U.S. cash markets and talk the Asian cash market was weak, traders said.
"The market was down on overnight selling and on signals of a downtick in the cash paddy market," a trader said.
Farmer storage is filling up and there has been an increase in producer selling, the traders said.
Rice futures closed three to five cents per cwt lower, with November down three at $9.99-1/2 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 550 contracts, up from 189 Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
